title: Toyota Tacoma Engines by Year (1995–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Toyota Tacoma by year, 1995–2026: the 2.4 and 2.7 fours, the 3.4, 4.0 and 3.5 V6s, and the 2.4 turbo and i-FORCE MAX hybrid.
intro: The Tacoma replaced Toyota's compact pickup in the US for 1995 and is now in its fourth generation.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 2.4 2RZ-FE and 2.7 3RZ-FE fours and the 3.4 5VZ-FE V6.
The 2.7 2TR-FE four and the 4.0 1GR-FE V6; ratings from 2006 reflect a change in the SAE test.
The 2.4 turbo four in two outputs and the i-FORCE MAX hybrid, rated for the combined output of engine and motor.
